review_description: Awesome communication, did the job when they said they would and it went without a hitch. Couldn’t ask for more + lots of good advice.

There was no pressure to buy. This system was better value for money than 2 previously quoted on. Systems were bigger than those previously quoted on for similar money and could accommodate all our electricity needs, including the hot water systems and cleaning a huge pool.The installation team were very efficient, professional, obliging and friendly.Yes, they were very helpful with advice and helped organize all the paper work.

Quote was competitive, owner operated business. Installers were polite and tidy and installation was done within a week of acceptance of quote. Everything went smoothly. The company are accredited REC installers so the panels came with 25 years product warranty.
local contractor for ease of  future contact
